card.name: Gestation day ranges in animal studies
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word (from, during, to, throughout) right before a gestation day number or stage such as organogenesis or lactation. It appears in animal reproduction toxicity text describing when pregnant animals were dosed.

modes.label: Space before day number
modes.description: The gap right after 'Gestation Day' or 'GD' and before the number that starts the dosing range.
